create_cohere_rerank: create a cohere rerank client that scores documents by relevance to a query
run_cohere_rerank_v1: run the cohere v1 client to rerank documents against a query using the BAAI/bge-reranker-base model
run_cohere_rerank_v2: run the cohere v2 client to rerank documents against a query using the BAAI/bge-reranker-base model
test_cohere_rerank: test the cohere rerank function with a query and list of documents
run_main: run the main entrypoint to execute both cohere v1 and v2 rerank clients
